规则依据：第02/03/04/05/08/09/14/23章。粘合 → 放量一阳: Playbook chapters 02/03/04/05/08/09/14/23: compression → volume breakout → 3–5-session confirmation → weekly / monthly alignment. Method notes distinguish guide thresholds from implementation choices.
核心五线固定为 MA5/10/20/30/60。长期120/250用于背景观察，: The fixed core uses MA5/10/20/30/60, with MA120/250 as background. The chart's eight adjustable MAs are independent. Compression = (highest MA − lowest MA) / lowest MA. Thresholds below 2% / 5% / 10% mean extreme / tight / loose compression.
指南明确给定：涨幅>5%、突破量>粘合期均量2倍、收盘高于MA60、后续3–5日: Guide thresholds: gain >5%, breakout volume >2× compression-period volume, close above MA60, 3–5 following sessions for confirmation, BIAS60 >20% risk, and review when KDJ J crosses below 80. Implementation choices: 5–20 compression sessions; 5-bar MA30/60 slopes with −0.1% tolerance; close in the upper 10% of the day's range; body midpoint deviation ≤25% as a preferred condition. Follow-up lows test the launch-body midpoint strictly.
量价时空页把当前量与前20根均量比较；价平具体化为涨跌幅绝对值<0.5%，量缩平: Volume compares the current bar with the prior 20. Flat price means absolute return <0.5%; low-volume flat trading is ≤0.8× and high-volume stagnation is ≥2×. These do not identify institutions. Weekly checks use a recent 5-bar crossover and MA30/60 compression <2%. Monthly checks use adjacent closed months. Unfinished weeks/months are excluded, including the current calendar month. OHLCV cannot identify actual holdings, order queues or intent; the guide's win-rate claims are not system probabilities.

These settings follow custom chart MAs. Playbook launch / confirmation markers independently use fixed MA5/10/20/30/60, prior compression, a volume breakout and 3–5 subsequent sessions. MACD histogram = 2 × (DIF − DEA). KDJ uses 9/3/3 recursion; J may exceed 0–100.
筛选采用姚记指南固定五线5/10/20/30/60；图表均线参数另行保留。潜在粘: Screening uses fixed playbook MAs 5/10/20/30/60, independently of chart settings. Compression candidates require <5%; strict launches require prior <2%. Pullback watch requires two lower-volume declining bars, MA10 support and non-declining MA5/10. Conditions are for inspection, not calibrated win rates. The activity ranking score caps volatility at 40 points, impulses at 25, volume expansion at 20 and historical follow-through at 15 (with ≥3 breakout samples). Estimated chip concentration is available in the daily chart. Licensed Level-2 remains unconnected.
筹码峰与集中度可查看量价模型估算；真实持仓、逐笔委托和队列保持待核验: Chip profile and concentration use a price/volume model; actual holdings and order queues remain unverified
按来源日线价格与每日高低收的三角分布分配成交筹码，以换手率衰减旧筹码，衰减系数1: Source daily prices use a triangular daily cost distribution. Turnover replaces old holdings with decay factor 1. The first day seeds the entire float. A larger remaining seed means greater dependence on initial assumptions. Concentration = (upper − lower) / (upper + lower) × 100%; smaller means more concentrated modeled costs.
这是公开量价数据推演，不是交易所真实持仓、主力成本或Level-2筹码。固定股本: This is a public price/volume model, not exchange holdings, institutional costs or Level-2. The constant-float fallback cannot reconstruct historical issuance or float changes. Values need not match broker models. Adjustment follows the selected daily source; corporate actions can distort raw-price histories.
